items: BUILT FOR COMFORT — Lightweight and Secure Fit for Sports, Running, and Workouts. Weighing only 0.3oz, these ear buds feature skin-friendly silicone ear hooks and a titanium alloy core that stays flexible and durable. The ergonomic design ensures a comfortable and secure fit, perfect for intense workouts, sports, and running, providing all-day comfort and stability.

LONG BATTERY LIFE — Up to 80 Hours of Total Playtime. Enjoy up to 15 hours of playtime on each ear bud, with an additional 65 hours provided by the charging case. A quick 15-minute charge gives you 2 hours of use, while a full 1-hour charge ensures you’re powered up for long sports sessions or workouts.

EASY CONTROL — Physical Buttons for Music and Calls. Each ear bud has dedicated physical buttons for volume control, music playback, and voice assistant access. You can easily adjust settings on the go without needing to touch your phone, making it perfect for running or workout routines.

CUSTOM FIT AND COMPLETE PACKAGE — 3 Sizes of Silicone Ear Tips and All Necessary Accessories. Choose from three sizes of silicone ear tips (S/M/L) to find the perfect fit for your ears. The ear buds ensure better comfort, fit, and noise isolation, staying securely in place during running or any sports activity. The package includes a detailed product manual, activation card, earbuds, charging case, Type C charging cable, and three sizes of silicone ear tips (M size is pre-attached), ensuring everything you need to get started.
